claims.text: The current materials used for sinking rollers, pulling rollers, and guide plates are prone to corrosion by high-temperature liquid aluminum.
A nickel-based alloy can be used to prepare dipping and plating equipment parts and protect them from erosion by liquid aluminum.
A ceramic material can be used to prepare dipping and plating equipment parts and protect them from erosion by liquid aluminum.
Nickel-based alloys possess sufficient corrosion resistance and high-temperature stability for the stated hot-dip aluminum plating conditions.
Ceramic materials possess sufficient corrosion resistance and high-temperature stability for the stated hot-dip aluminum plating conditions.
Nickel-based alloys resist corrosion by liquid aluminum and thereby reduce erosion of equipment components.
Ceramic materials resist corrosion by liquid aluminum and thereby reduce erosion of equipment components.
Reduced corrosion will increase the service life of the equipment components.
